description: Decode the vocabulary the other cern_opendata tools accept: experiments, record types, collision energies and types, file formats and data tiers, availability states, physics categories, LHCb magnet polarities and stripping streams and versions, identifier forms, query syntax, licensing, and the CMS run periods that have validated-run lists. Static and offline; omit topic for every table.

topic.description: One table to return: experiments, record_types, collision_energies, collision_types, file_types, availability, categories, lhcb, identifiers, query_syntax, licensing or run_periods. Omit for every table.

name: cern_opendata_list_reference

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

topics.description: The requested table, or every table when topic is omitted.

meaning.description: What the value means and where it applies.

value.description: A value or query form, spelled exactly as the tools accept it; in the identifiers and licensing topics, the name of an identifier form or a licensing rule.

summary.description: What the table covers and how its values are matched or normalized.

topic.description: Topic name, as accepted by the topic input.

title: List Reference Vocabulary
